## About
Steve's Auto has been part of the Parma area for a long time. We fix small or major damage across a wide variety of vehicle makes, using high quality replacement parts at fair prices, with a fast turnaround.
Customers know Steve by name. One reviewer says Steve has serviced his used cars over the years, sometimes doing the work that was needed and other times telling him when he didn't need something. That's how we like to work.
We're rated 4.1 on Google from 51 reviews. Our hours have changed, so please call first before you come by.

## Services
- All kinds of auto repair work: Minor or major damage, across a wide variety of vehicle makes, with original replacement parts available.
- Steering and suspension: Clunks, pulls and worn parts checked and repaired.
- Computer-aided engine diagnostics: When the engine is running poorly, we find the cause before we start replacing parts.
- Air-conditioning service: If the air-conditioning is on strike again, the staff is happy to get it working.
- Pre purchase inspections: Have a used car looked over before you buy it.
- Tires and Winter Service: Good Year, Cooper, Uniroyal and Kelly are among our main tire lines, quoted installed and out the door.
- Pennzoil and full synthetic oil: We carry Pennzoil products and keep full synthetic oils in stock for your oil change.
- Interstate batteries: Interstate batteries kept on hand, so a dead battery doesn't have to wait.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Thursday, 7:00 AM to 2:00 PM. We're closed Friday, Saturday and Sunday. Our hours have been modified, so please call first.

Q: Can I get an estimate before I bring my car in?
A: Yes. Fill out the contact form with your name, email, phone and a note about the problem, and we'll get back to you.

Q: My car failed the E check. Can you help?
A: Yes. A failed E check, a rattling muffler or an air-conditioner that quit are all problems the Steve's Auto staff is happy to solve.

Q: Which tire brands do you carry?
A: Our main lines include Good Year, Cooper, Uniroyal and Kelly, and every tire price is quoted installed and out the door.
